WP6.role: Only measured affinity inputs to the numerical model
WP6.assay: Fluorescence indicator displacement; 1:1 binding inferred from Job plots; nonlinear fitting in PBS pH 7.2 at 298 K
WP6.source_location: Results paragraph beginning Next, fluorescence titrations were performed
WP6.repeat_statement: Measurement repeated three times for each experiment; uncertainty definition not established in the inspected main text
WP6.arithmetic_correction: Main text says approximately an order of magnitude, but listed central caffeine constants are only 2.70 and 2.75 times the two listed methylxanthine constants
WP6.licence: Article XML states CC BY; derived constants and attribution only are published
transfer_limits: No human caffeine reversal or sleep endpoint

P6AS.role: Qualitative mechanism precedent only; none of its constants enter the WP6 model
P6AS.evidence_reviewed: Primary author manuscript searchable through PMC; measured different drug/host pairs in water and mouse hyperlocomotion outcomes
P6AS.comparison: Sulfated P6AS differs from carboxylato WP6; methamphetamine differs from caffeine; affinity or mouse functional reversal cannot transfer between pairs
transfer_limits: Not an oral caffeine reversal study
No evidence here that stimulant peptides are categorically easier to capture
